content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Seattle

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's baseline requirements—typically a bachelor's degree plus months of direct project experience, or equivalent alternative pathways. Gather transcripts and project documentation before enrolling to ensure you meet the credential's standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule—no travel required, no fixed Seattle classroom. You'll cover all five process groups and ten knowledge areas PMI mandates, with direct access to your instructor throughout.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your contact hours, apply directly through PMI's platform. Report your education and project experience, upload verification documents, and remit PMI's examination fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and avoid delays in approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your computerized exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in the Seattle area or online. You'll have four hours to demonstrate mastery of the PMBOK Guide and real-world project scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to PMI's three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or publication. Renew your credential and membership fees before expiration. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education options to help you fulfill PDU requirements and stay current in project management.
